fuel_consumption.source_quote: As of December 31, 2022, we have hedged 8.8% of our projected fuel requirement for the first quarter of 2023.

instrument_type_details.notes: 450 thousand barrels at Dec 31 2022 (450k x 42 = 18.9M gallons). Instruments described as 'aircraft fuel call option spread agreements'. Only Q1 2023 hedged at 8.8% at filing date; subsequent hedges for Q2 (19.3%) and Q3 (5.5%) added in Feb 2023. Actual 2022 consumption hedged was 7%. Company resumed hedging in 2022 after no hedges in 2021.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel consumption increased by 21.0%, or 146 million gallons, in 2022 due to capacity increases; 2021 was 696M; 2022 = 842M (from Item 7 Aircraft Fuel section)
